entries.title: Bring secrets from another tool on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: When a crewmate asks to bring secrets from another tool, such as Automic Vault or a .env file, its card on your iPhone and iPad now shows one tick box per secret, as your computer's window does. Tick the ones to keep and tap Bring into Secrets, or tap Read it to list the names a file holds first, or Don't bring. No value ever reaches the phone. With a keyboard on an iPad, Tab reaches the tick boxes, the arrows move between them, Space ticks and Return brings.
entries.noPicture: The hero pair comes from the phone check's pictures of the bring card, which run once the change is reviewed.
